purpose: Pin the evidence architecture for the sorting-buffering Nature Ecology & Evolution flagship.

projection_sources.claim_ceiling: Discussion and prospective measurement design only; not external validation of the synthetic closure.

claim_firewalls: Natural examples do not validate the simulator or the finite mechanism decompositions.
EGWEE natural analyses are not a coequal mechanistic Result.
Fragmentation is not claimed to cause the original aligned/anti-aligned construction.
Omitted alignment is not claimed to cause warning-threshold failure.
Generation 20 is not a universal biological threshold or natural-system timescale.
The original locked +5 percentage-point propagation result is not interpreted as a universally reproducible directional alignment effect.
Support variance, alignment and refugia are not treated as universal directional risk scores.
Allele-linked recruitment is not claimed to generate the AA matching advantage; the locked edge-deletion experiment identifies it as a countervailing buffer in the q-only closure.

Local ecological selection is resolved as a joint late sorting block, and the focused 6,000-pair experiment separately resolves local q-dependent allele selection as a single-edge causal contributor within the q-only closure.
The exact q-dependent allele-sorting theorem and q*=0.625 switch are properties of the declared closure, not universal natural laws.
Density-to-q feedback is treated as a failure/amplification gate; the zero-event generation-20 deletion is not interpreted as clean matching-specific mediation.
Sorting, buffering and the observed horizons are bounded properties of the declared finite closure, not universal natural laws.
Urban, island, forest fragment and volcanic disturbance are upstream histories, not identified regimes by themselves.
No natural systems are pooled to manufacture one ecological effect.
Substantially overlapping fallback manuscripts must not be simultaneously submitted with an active flagship.
